rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to add another piece of information or supporting point.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is good; furthermore, the prices are not expensive.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好食，而且價錢又唔貴。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 ji4 ce2 gaa3 cin2 jau6 m4 gwai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for an additional point, especially with a sense of “what’s more” or emphasis.

example.english: They arrived late, and furthermore, they did not bring the documents.
example.traditional: 佢唔單止遲到，仲冇帶文件。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 ci4 dou3 zung6 mou5 daai3 man4 gin2

rows.note: Use this when introducing a separate additional point, roughly “besides” or “additionally.”

example.english: Furthermore, it will rain tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella.
example.traditional: 另外，聽日會落雨，記得帶遮。
example.jyutping: ling6 ngoi6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this for the conversational “and also” sense when linking another action, fact, or item.

example.english: I have to work tomorrow, and furthermore, I have to go to the bank.
example.traditional: 我聽日要返工，同埋要去銀行辦事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 tung4 maai4 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 baan6 si6
